title: dVRK control panel configuration
description: Optional control panel settings. Annotations are off by default; use -a or include an annotations object to enable them.

name.description: Settings key used to persist window and appearance preferences.

video_source.description: Preferred stereo sockets; each appears as separate left and right eye views. Only stereo_source, stereo_alignment and stereo_display overlay sockets are auto-discovered.

annotations.description: Presence of this object enables annotations; gst_output optionally overrides the output socket. Annotation input is the final stereo_display overlay stream.
